name: Bluetooth
description: Connect, disconnect, pair, scan and power Bluetooth devices
author: spotty
help:
Trigger: bt

Type "bt" to see your Bluetooth status and devices:
- Enter toggles the adapter on/off
- Connected devices: Enter to disconnect
- Available devices: Enter to connect (unpaired ones pair first)
- "Scan for devices" discovers new devices

Type "bt <query>" to filter the list by device name or MAC address.
